title: OMG SysML v2.0 Language manual visual ledger: Section 7.17 action examples, printed pages 101-113

source.title: OMG Systems Modeling Language (SysML) Version 2.0, Part 1: Language Specification

review_method: Rendered physical pages 133-145 were manually and visually inspected. PDF/layout extraction was used only for navigation and token cross-checking; the rendered page determined source-block boundaries, continuation relationships, and contextual/lexical status. Every source_code value below is joined directly from the reviewed raw lines, with no token correction or invented omission.
